$comment: What npm metadata cannot say about what Studio ships (#1612). Read by scripts/generate-licences.mjs; every entry says why it is here.

dompurify.reason: Dual-licensed; Studio takes it under Apache-2.0.

json-schema.reason: Dual-licensed; Studio takes it under BSD-3-Clause.

elkjs.reason: Dual-licensed; Studio takes it under EPL-2.0, whose source is at the repository below. Bundled through mermaid for graph layout.

khroma.reason: Its package.json has no license field; the licence file it ships is MIT.

remark-math.reason: Ships no licence file; package.json says MIT.

@defasm/core.reason: Ships no licence file; package.json says ISC and names Defectus as its author.

@ai-sdk/provider-utils.reason: Ships no licence file; package.json says Apache-2.0. Part of the Vercel AI SDK.

include.name: monaco-editor
include.reason: Copied into the app whole as an asset (min/vs), so the bundle does not list it. Its ThirdPartyNotices.txt covers the code it carries from others, the codicon font among them.

components.name: Chromium, Node.js, V8, FFmpeg and their dependencies
components.notice: Electron carries Chromium, Node.js, V8 and FFmpeg. Their licences, and those of everything they include, are in LICENSES.chromium.html, which is installed with the application.

components.name: Hero Patterns
components.unverified: Credited as MIT in _textures.scss; to be confirmed in #1613.
